case.question: How do I reboot the module if it freezes?
case.expected_behavior: Pull the reset pin (pin 17) low for 100-500 ms, or use a restart command.

result.question: How do I reboot the module if it freezes?
result.answer: If the module is abnormal or the software does not respond, you can reset it by pulling Pin 17 (RSTN) low for 100-500ms [HW-v5.3-p031-2]. Alternatively, the module supports an AT command reset using the command AT+TRB to restart the module [HW-v5.3-p031-2]. If using the C16QS EVK, there is also a dedicated Reset Key available to reset the module [EVK-v1.1-p012-1].

result.question: How do I switch the EVK between USB power and a wall adapter?
result.answer: To switch between voltage sources on the Cavli C16QS EVK, use Jumper 3 (JMP 3). Placing the jumper in the first position enables USB Type-C as the input voltage source, while the second position enables the +5V Adapter as the voltage source [EVK-v1.1-p012-1].

case.question: How can I tell that the module has joined the mobile network?
case.expected_behavior: Network status indication pin/LED (NET_STATUS); on the EVK the NETLIGHT LED.

result.question: How can I tell that the module has joined the mobile network?
result.answer: The module indicates it has joined the network via the NET_STATUS pin (pin 21 or 75), which drives a network status LED [HW-v5.3-p039-3, HW-v5.3-p040-1]. When the module is registered to a 4G network, or a non-4G network for voice, SMS, and other services, the LED will be Constantly Bright [HW-v5.3-p040-1].

The following tables describe the pin definition and logic level changes of NETLIGHT in different network activity status.
